_note: ADDED for #79, when the whole ward became addressable. barks.json is the owner's canon and is not edited; barkRawsFiles() loads the owner's file FIRST and it wins every duplicate key, so nothing here can shadow anything authored. These tables cover the one thing 210 authored tables could not: what a body's own SIMULATED STATE sounds like. The ward tracks hunger, rest and the walk home per person, and until now a starving rope-hand greeted you with a remark about the weather. Every table is keyed <state> or <state>.<family>, most specific first, so a hungry watchman and a hungry priest are two different sentences.

rows: Talk if you like. I am thinking about bread.
On my feet since the bell with nothing in me but tea.
You are not carrying food, are you. No. Nobody ever is.
My belly is louder than you are. Say it quickly.
Half a shift left and the crib empty. That is the day.
A man hauls better fed. Nobody has ever agreed with me on that.
Ask me at supper. I am kinder at supper.
Move along. I am hungry, and that makes me thorough.
Post till dark and the pot gone cold at the guardhouse. Your business, quickly.
Do not stand in front of a hungry spear. It is a poor habit.
I gave my share to the bunkroom. The right sum, the wrong hour.
Hunger is honest company. Speak, and I will ignore it.
The Mission eats last, and today the Mission eats late.
Shelves full, purse thin, and I have not sat since dawn.
I will sell you anything but my dinner, and I have not had that either.
Be quick. The moment this queue thins I am going to eat.
Ship's biscuit twice and nothing since. Say your piece.
Salt does not fill a man. Somebody should have told me at fifteen.
There is a pot at the Bilge with my name on it and no coin under it.
You buying? No. Nobody is ever buying.
Two days on tide-wrack and rainwater. I will talk for a crust.
Look at me and guess what I want. You will have it first go.
Beasts fed. Me, not yet. That is the order it goes in.
The goats eat before I do, and they know it.
Feed-bag is empty both ends of it today.
I have not eaten in days. Say what you came to say.
There is a ringing in my ears and it is not the bell.
Ask me for nothing. I have nothing left to give anyone.
(the words come slowly, and cost something)
Days now. The gulls eat better on this quay and they know it.
I would take bread off a dead man. I tell you so you know what I am.
(he does not look up)
The Flame is warmest to those with nothing. I am testing that.
I gave the last of it away. I would do it again, and it frightens me.
Do not tell the bunkroom. They would only share theirs.
The wage is three weeks late and the pot has been empty for two.
I am past hungry and into something quieter. State your business.
I have been awake a long while. Be brief and I will thank you.
Say it twice. The first will not reach me.
I am standing out of habit, not strength.
There is a bed with my name on it and I cannot recall where.
Fourteen hours on this stone. Ask, and ask plainly.
I am too tired to be careful with you. Consider that.
Night beat and no relief. Do not be interesting.
Two watches end to end, and the tide does not care.
I can sleep standing. I have done it in worse weather.
Talk. If I shut my eyes it is not rudeness.
Rope all day and the crane after. These arms are somebody else's.
Third double this week. Say it and let me sit.
I have stopped feeling my hands. That is usually a Tuesday.
The night office runs long and the ward wakes early. Both are true.
I will hear you. I may not remember it.
Sleep is a mercy I keep recommending and never taking.
Slept an hour under a hull and got moved on twice.
You try resting where every boot in the ward walks.
Walking home. Walk with me or say it here.
Shift is done. Whatever it is, it can be short.
I am for my own door, and a shut one at that.
Done for the day and glad of it. Quickly, then.
Home, supper, and no more rope until the bell.
Whatever it is, it will keep till the muster.
Relieved, and off the clock. Try the post at the Rise.
Not my hour any more. Go and be somebody else's trouble.
Off duty. That means the spear is, too.
Shutters up and the till counted. Tomorrow.
Shut. I would say come back, and I mean it, but not tonight.
The day rate ended with the day.
Off to find a dry arch before somebody better at it does.
My bed is a doorway on the Ropewynd. Do not follow me to it.
Going where the wind is not. Do not make it a conversation.
Back to the hull before the watch changes.
Ashore an hour and I have spent it walking. Say on.
To the bunks. The Flame keeps its own hours and so, tonight, do I.
I am going in. Knock at the Mission and somebody will answer.
